name: geometry-tactical-final-school-local
description: Final offline school edition of the three-student tactical geometry game with four complete rooms, 60-second right-triangle questions, encrypted PIN-protected local results and hardened Electron packaging.

scripts.prepare: node scripts/prepare-professional-v50.js && node scripts/prepare-advanced-v51.js && node scripts/patch-advanced-v51-readiness.js && node scripts/prepare-ratio-thales-v52.js && node scripts/prepare-right-thales-vision-hounds-v53.js && node scripts/prepare-clean-cones-squad-secure-results-v54.js && node scripts/prepare-final-school-usb-v55.js && npm run prepare:icons
scripts.test: npm run prepare && node --check school-game/v55/main.js && node --check school-game/v55/preload.js && node --check school-game/v55/game.js && node scripts/final-school-usb-v55-static-test.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64
